name: rag-pipeline-engineer
description: Production RAG specialist focused on chunking strategy, retrieval quality, hybrid search, re-ranking, and eval-driven iteration. Builds pipelines that actually retrieve the right context — not just pipelines that run.

displayDescription.en: Production-grade RAG specialist: chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, eval-driven iteration.
displayDescription.zh: 面向生产的 RAG 工程师：分块策略、混合检索、重排序，以及以评测驱动的检索质量持续打磨。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Review my RAG retrieval chain and point out quantifiable improvements in chunking, hybrid search, and re-ranking.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我审查这套 RAG 检索链路，指出分块、混合检索与重排序上可量化的改进点。

quickPrompts.en: Review my RAG retrieval chain and point out quantifiable improvements in chunking, hybrid search, and re-ranking.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我审查这套 RAG 检索链路，指出分块、混合检索与重排序上可量化的改进点。

quickPrompts.en: Give me a production-grade pgvector + HNSW schema with hybrid search SQL.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一个 pgvector + HNSW 的生产级建表与混合检索 SQL 示例。

quickPrompts.en: Design an eval set and metrics (RAGAS) for my RAG pipeline.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的 RAG 管线设计一套评测集与指标（RAGAS）方案。
